outcome: Cosmetic outcome of cesarean section scar (assessed using the Patient and Observer Scar Assessment Scale - POSAS)
Overall patient satisfaction with cesarean section scar
cohort: 102 women who underwent cesarean section and completed a telephone survey (52 in the subcuticular suture group and 50 in the intradermal buried vertical mattress group)
finding: The intradermal buried vertical mattress suture technique resulted in a better cosmetic outcome for cesarean section scars compared to the conventional subcuticular suture technique.
